start.text: (The woman from room 1, on her step, a cloth wound round her forearm.) You're the top room. I'm Deepa. I was at the lab — HIVR. One of them got me on the walk home.

arm.text: (Two crescents of teeth. The skin round them has gone grey.) Fresh. There's a window. A small one.

need.text: Ward 4 at Hebbal General gave the first cases an antiviral course. It cures nothing. It slows it. If a strip is left in the nurses' desk... I can't walk that far.

go.text: The service road, not the flyover — they hear you up there. And the ward... they didn't all leave.

waiting.text: Ward 4. The nurses' desk, the end drawer.

given.text: (She reads the strip twice and swallows two, dry.) It slows it. That's all it does. (A long breath.) Thank you.

after.text: (Paler. Sitting up.) Still me. For now.
